pages.title: Somnium Ward
pages.text: Phantom essence, a crystal shard and the heart of a soul guard give this draught its strength. Drink it and a cyan ward settles on your hearts for 2 minutes, covering as many of them as you have, up to 10.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Every blow strikes the ward before it reaches your life, and each one breaks a piece of it away. Watch the cyan outlines on your hearts: while they shine, you are shielded. Once the last of them fades, you bleed as usual.

pages.title: Recipe
notes: Place Somnium and loran energy in the upper input slots.
Place the required items in the test tubes on the left and right.
